dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you tell me about Sangonomiya Shrine?

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: This shrine is the heart of Watatsumi Island, and is run by Her Excellency. It is an offering to our deity, Watatsumi Omikami.

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: Well, I call it an offering, but this isn't actually where the body of Watatsumi Omikami lies.

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: However, the large coral that can be found outside the palace courts were indeed taken from Watatsumi Omikami's very own body... Probably.

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't really know the details myself. If you want to know more, why not ask the shrine maiden over there?

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: ...That said, she's been quite troubled of late by that researcher. Either way, good luck.
